Narrative and Plans for the Type 1 Rezoning of 3939-41 W. Dickens Avenue
from an M1-1 District to an RT-4 District

The subject property is improved with a one story commercial building. The
applicant needs a zoning change to demolish the existing building and meet the bulk and
density standards to allow a residential use and to sub-divide an existing zoning lot into
two new zoning lots measuring 25’x125.50’ and build one new 3-unit residential building
on each new lot for a total of two new buildings containing six dwelling units.

A. Proposed Land Use: Rezone from M1-1 District to an RT-4 District to subdivide an
existing zoning lot into two zoning lots each measuring 25’ x 125.50’ and build one
new 3-unit residential building on each lot for a total of two buildings.

B. Project’s floor area ratio — FAR — will be 1.2 — 7,524 SF

C. Project’s lot size is 6,275 SF and the density is 1,045 SF per dwelling unit.

D. The amount of off-street parking is 6 parking spaces. Applicant will provide parking
or seek TSL parking relief, if necessary.

E. Setbacks:

Front — 6-5”
East —3’-0”
Rear — 30’- 0”
West — 3’-0”

F. The project building height will be 38’-0”

The Type-1 map amendment sits in the industrial corridor, and will comply with section 17-13-
0400 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance. Applicant will comply with section 17-2-0301-C
Exceptions to the Chicago Air Quality Ordinance should such provisions be determined to be

applicable.
